questions.question: If the tenth day of a month having 30 days is Tuesday, then what day of the week will the last day of the same month be?
questions.solution:
Given:

Tenth day of a month having 30 days is Tuesday → 10th is Tuesday

10th + 7th → 17th is Tuesday

17th + 7th → 24th is Tuesday

25th → Wednesday

26th → Thursday

27th → Friday

28th → Saturday

29th → Sunday

30th → Monday

Hence, the correct answer is** "Monday".**

questions.question: If 19 July 2000 was a Wednesday, then what would be the day of the week on 15 June 2012?
questions.solution:
Odd days:

A non-leap year has 365 days and a leap year has 366 days.

**Non-leap year =** 365 days or 52 weeks and 1 day. So, here the number of odd days is 1.

**Leap year =** 366 days or 52 weeks and 2 days So, here the number of odd days are 2.

Leap year between 2000 to 2012 = 2004, 2008 and 2012

And,

The non-leap year between 2000 and 2012 = 2001, 2002, 2003, 2005, 2006, 2007, 2009, 2010 and 2011

So, total number of odd day between 2000 and 2012 = 9 (Total Non- leap year) + 2 + 2 + 2 = 15 days = 1 odd day

questions.question: If 16 January 2015 was Friday, then what was the day of the week on 16 January 2010?
questions.solution:
Given: 16 January 2015 was Friday.

The same date occurs on the next day of the week every year. So if we want to calculate in back date we have to count backward:

 
• 16 January 2015 was Friday.
 
• 16 January 2014 was Thursday.
 
• 16 January 2013 was Wednesday.
 
• 16 January 2012 was Monday (It is a leap year with 2 odd days so it will not be Tuesday).
 
• 16 January 2011 was Sunday.
 
• **16 January 2010 was Saturday.**

Hence **the correct answer is option 4.**

questions.question: Vilas remembers his marriage is after 4th July. While his sister remembers his marriage is before 6th July. On which date of July is his marriage?
questions.solution: Vilas remembers his marriage is after 4th July (i.e. on 5th, 6th, 7th, etc.) while his sister remembers his marriage is before 6th July (i.e. on 5th, 4th, 3rd etc.). Combining both the statements we get only one possible date which is 5th July.

questions.question: If 12 May 2011 was a Thursday, then what was the day of the week on 10 May 2004?
questions.solution:
12 May 2011 = Thursday

Number of years between 2004 and 2011 = 7 

Number of leap years between 2004 and 2011 = 1

So, total number of odd days = (7 + 1)/7 = 8/7 = 1 (remainder)

As, 12 may 2011 = Thursday

So, 12 May 2004 = Wednesday (Decrease 1 day as 1 odd day)

So, 10 May 2004 = Monday

Hence, **"Monday"** is the correct answer.

questions.question: Advik's birthday is on Monday 19thJune. On what day of the week will be Nishith's Birthday in the same year if Nishith was born on 17th November?
questions.solution:
Advik's birthday → 19 June, Monday

Nishith’s birthday → 17 November

So, June has the remaining → 11 Days

July → 31 Days

August → 31 Days

September → 30 Days

October → 31 Days

November → 17 Days

Total Days → 151 Days

Dividing 151 days by 7 (as there are 7 days in a week)

We get the remainder 4

Thus, 4 days ahead of Monday will be Friday which is the day on which Nishith’s birthday will fall.

Hence, the answer is Friday.
